Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 24

“These worlds would fall to ruin if I did not perform action. I would be the cause of chaos and would destroy these creatures.”

An unusually stark statement of consequence. Krishna is describing responsibility that scales with capacity, which is precisely the argument being made to Arjuna about his own.
